sentences.en: A straight line is a trivial example of a curve.
sentences.zh: 一条直线是一个曲线的例子。

sentences.en: I went all over her curves, all night, without wearying.
sentences.zh: 我一整晚都在她的曲线上游走，从不厌倦。

sentences.en: His car spun out of control going around the curve.
sentences.zh: 他的车在转弯时失去了控制。

senses.zh: 曲线；弯曲；曲线球；曲线图表 -
